creative_direction.concept: A decisive, CFO-friendly pricing grid with a confident teal accent, sharply defined hierarchy, and an odometer-style price transition that makes the yearly savings unmistakable without visual noise.
creative_direction.audience_and_context: B2B buyers (founders, PMs, ops leads, finance) comparing vendors during work hours on desktop/laptop; often shared in Slack/email. They want fast clarity, honest per-seat math, and a clear recommended option. Accessibility and legibility are non-negotiable.
directions_considered: Asymmetric 2-up hero with the recommended plan centered and elevated; left/right flanking plans are secondary with reduced chroma.
Dense comparison table first, then sticky card summary on scroll with in-row plan toggles for decision capture.
Narrative flow: problem-solution bullets leading into a progressive-disclosure selector that reveals the correct plan by needs (team size, SSO, support).
creative_direction.chosen_direction_rationale: The elevated-center, three-card grid gets teams to a decision fastest: immediate scan, one clear recommendation, and a single global billing toggle. It outperforms tables for first-impression clarity while still accommodating a concise feature list. It’s also simpler to implement, responsive-friendly, and shares cleanly as a snapshot link.
creative_direction.typography:
Google Fonts pairing: Display — Space Grotesk (600/700) for prices and headings; Text — Manrope (400/500/600) for body and UI.
Type scale (px, 1.25 modular, base 16):
- Display XL: 56/64 lh, Space Grotesk 700
- H1: 40/48 lh, Space Grotesk 700
- H2: 32/40 lh, Space Grotesk 700
- H3: 24/32 lh, Space Grotesk 600
- Body L: 18/28 lh, Manrope 400/500
- Body M (base): 16/24 lh, Manrope 400/500
- Caption: 14/20 lh, Manrope 500
- Micro: 12/16 lh, Manrope 500
creative_direction.spacing_and_layout:
Spacing scale (4/8px rhythm): 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80.
Grid: 12 columns, 72px max content measure for text blocks, 24px gutters, container max-width 1200px (desktop), 720px (tablet), fluid on mobile with 16px side padding.
Card grid: Desktop 3× equal columns; Tablet 2× (recommended spans 2); Mobile stacked (recommended first).
creative_direction.shape_and_elevation:
Radii: card 12px, button 8px, input 8px, pill 999px.
Elevation: 
- e0: none
- e1: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.06)
- e2: 0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.08)
- e3 (highlighted): 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)
Borders: 1px solid var(--color-border). Recommended card uses e3 + 2px accent top rule.
creative_direction.motion: Durations: micro 150ms, standard 200ms, emphasized 260ms. Easing: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); entrance springs for price odometer: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1). Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable numeral flip; fade+instant value swap instead.
creative_direction.signature_moment: The yearly toggle triggers an odometer flip on the numeric price with a synchronized ‘Save 20% yearly’ pill that gently snaps to the recommended card’s CTA, emphasizing the best value without shouting.
creative_direction.iconography_and_imagery: Icon style: 2px stroke, rounded joins, geometric (Feather/Lucide-like). Usage limited to checks, info tooltips, and a subtle star for ‘Recommended’. No illustrations or stock imagery; this is a decision screen.
creative_direction.voice_and_tone: Plain-spoken, number-first, respectful. Avoid hype; state inclusions, limits, and per-seat math clearly. Use verbs that imply action and ownership (Start, Upgrade, Talk to sales).
avoid: Table sprawl with dozens of rows

screens:
Pricing — Desktop (≥1280px):
- Header band (full width): Page title left, toggle right. Container 1200px centered, 40px top/bottom padding.
  • Left: H1 “Pricing that scales with your team” (H1, 40px), subcopy Body L with 72ch max.
  • Right: BillingPeriodToggle (Monthly | Yearly — Save 20%) aligned to top, ARIA group label “Billing period”.
- Plans grid (surface background): 64px top padding, 48px bottom. 12-col grid; each card spans 4 cols with 24px gutters.
  • Card anatomy (Starter, Team [recommended], Enterprise):
    - Top rule: 2px accent only on recommended; others 1px border top in border color.
    - Header row: Plan name (H3), short tagline (Caption), Recommended badge (Team only, pill with star icon) right-aligned.
    - Price block: Large price (H1 for Team, H2 for others) with odometer numerals, ‘/seat/mo’ label; yearly state shows ‘billed yearly’ note.
    - Feature list: 6 items, each FeatureRow with check icon; overflow wraps to next line with 20px line-height.
    - CTA: Primary button full-width (Team), secondary outline for Starter, ghost or ‘Contact sales’ for Enterprise.
    - Footnote: Micro text (12px) for limits or SSO/SLA notes.
  • Visual emphasis: Team card uses elevation e3, 8px upward translate on hover/focus, subtle glow on accent top rule.
- Footnotes row: Single line explaining taxes, currency, and overage in Body S (14px), left-aligned.
- SEO FAQ (optional): 3 concise accordions below grid (kept collapsed by default).

Pricing — Tablet (768–1279px):
- Container max 720px with 24px gutters.
- Header stacks: H1, subcopy, then toggle full-width.
- Grid: two cards per row; Team card spans full width on its own row and remains visually elevated.
- Price numerals scale down 1 step (H1→H2 for Team, H2→H3 others). Buttons remain 48px tall.

Pricing — Mobile (360–767px):
- 16px side padding, 24px top/bottom rhythm.
- Header: H1 (32px), subcopy (16px), toggle as full-width segmented control.
- Cards stack: Team card first, then Starter, then Enterprise. Each card fills width; CTAs full-width 100%.
- Price odometer switches to fade-swap on reduced motion or narrow widths to avoid jank.
components:
BillingPeriodToggle (Segmented Control)
- Anatomy: container (pill, role='radiogroup'), two buttons (Monthly, Yearly), savings pill (Yearly option), focus ring.
- Tokens: height 40px (mobile 44px), padding 4px, gap 4px, radius 999px, border 1px var(--color-border), active thumb uses --color-accent.
- States: default, hover, focus-visible (2px outline), selected, disabled.
- Accessibility: Arrow keys move focus; Space/Enter selects; aria-pressed or aria-checked on options; group label via aria-labelledby.

PlanCard
- Variants: starter | team-recommended | enterprise.
- Anatomy: container (card), top rule, header (plan name, tagline, badge), price block (currency symbol, price odometer, cadence), per-seat note, feature list (ul>li FeatureRow), CTA, footnote.
- Sizing: max-width 360–400px each (desktop), full-width on smaller.
- Tokens: card radius 12px, padding 24–32px, elevation e1/e3, border 1px.
- Emphasis: team-recommended uses e3, accent top rule 2px, larger price size, primary solid CTA.

RecommendedBadge
- Anatomy: pill with star icon-left, label 'Recommended'.
- Tokens: bg var(--color-surface), text var(--color-text), border 1px var(--color-border), radius 999px, padding 4px 8px.
- State: visible only on team-recommended.

PriceOdometer
- Anatomy: stack of digits per place, masked with overflow hidden (clip), mono-spaced tabular numerals via font-feature-settings: 'tnum'.
- Motion: vertical translateY flip per digit 200ms stagger 20ms; reduced-motion: opacity crossfade 120ms.

FeatureRow
- Anatomy: 2px stroke check icon (success color), label text.
- Behavior: wraps to 2 lines; long text truncates at 2 lines on mobile with title attr for full.
- Tokens: gap 12px, icon size 20px.

Button
- Variants: primary (accent), secondary (outline), tertiary (ghost), link.
- Tokens: height 48px, radius 8px, padding 0 16px, focus ring 2px offset 2px, typography Manrope 600.
- States: default, hover (elevation or bg tint), focus-visible, pressed (2px translateY), disabled (40% opacity, no shadow), loading (spinner replaces label, aria-live polite).

Tooltip
- Anatomy: trigger (info icon), content box, caret.
- Tokens: radius 8px, shadow e2, bg #0B1220, text #FFFFFF, padding 8px 12px.
- Accessibility: aria-describedby, ESC closes, focus trap not required (non-modal).
interactions: Toggle: Click or keyboard selection switches billingPeriod (monthly↔yearly), updates URL ?billing=monthly|yearly without full reload, triggers PriceOdometer animation. Timing: 200ms; easing: ease-out; reduced-motion: instant swap.
Recommended emphasis: On toggle, ‘Save 20% yearly’ pill animates 12px toward the Team CTA and snaps, 200ms. Hover/focus on Team card lifts 8px with shadow e3; exits faster than enter.

CTA buttons: Click on Starter/Team leads to checkout with plan and period params (?plan=team&billing=yearly). Enterprise opens mailto or routes to /contact-sales with prefilled plan. Buttons show loading state until navigation confirmed.

Keyboard: Tab order: page title → toggle (Monthly then Yearly) → cards left-to-right/top-to-bottom → each CTA → footnotes. Left/Right keys switch toggle options. Enter activates focused control. Focus ring never removed.
Tooltips: Hover/focus on ‘per seat’ info shows tooltip; dismiss on blur, ESC, or click outside.
Deep link: If URL contains #team or #starter/#enterprise, that card scrolls into view and receives a temporary 2s accent outline for orientation.
states: Buttons: default (solid accent), hover (darken accent by 6%), focus-visible (2px accent ring with 2px offset), pressed (translateY(1px), shadow reduced), disabled (opacity 0.4, cursor not-allowed), loading (spinner + aria-busy).
Toggle options: default (surface), hover (surface tint), focus-visible (2px accent ring), selected (accent bg + on-accent text), disabled (reduced opacity, not focusable).
PlanCard: default (e1), hover (e2 + translateY(4px) non-recommended; e3 + translateY(8px) recommended), focus-visible (accent ring inside padding), pressed (slight compress), disabled (not used).
PriceOdometer: default digits visible; animating state on change; reduced-motion = fade. Error fallback shows ‘—’.
Loading/Skeleton: While fetching pricing, render 3 skeleton cards with shimmer bars for title (60%), price (40px block), 5 feature lines, and disabled CTAs.
Empty/Edge: If API returns zero features, hide feature list container and expand tagline spacing; if price is 0, show ‘Free’ and hide per-seat line; long feature text wraps up to 2 lines on mobile.
Error: Network/API error shows inline banner above grid: ‘We couldn’t load pricing. Retry.’ with secondary button. Cards show fallback static prices if provided in config.

responsive:
Breakpoints: 360, 768, 1280.
- 1280+: 12-col grid, three cards across (span 4). Recommended centered. Toggle aligned right of header.
- 768–1279: Container 720px. Header stacks; toggle full-width. Grid shows Team on its own row (span 12), Starter/Enterprise share row below (span 6 each).
- ≤767: Stacked cards, Team first. Buttons stretch 100%. Increase body text to 16/26 and hit targets ≥48px. Long feature lines clamp to 2 lines with expand on tap (optional).
- Assets: Use tabular-nums CSS for prices to avoid layout shift. Reserve price block height to prevent CLS on toggle.
- Focus management: On deep-link or period change, do not reset scroll; only animate within cards.
api_needs: GET /api/pricing?period=monthly|yearly&currency=USD — returns: [{ id, name, tagline, monthly_price_cents, yearly_price_cents, currency, features: string[], footnote?: string, order: number, recommended?: boolean }].
GET /api/config — returns: { yearly_discount_percent: number, currencies: string[], default_currency: string }.
POST /api/checkout/sessions — body: { plan_id, period, seats, currency } → { checkout_url } for Starter/Team.
POST /api/sales/intake — body: { plan_id:'enterprise', email, company, seats, notes } → { ticket_id } or route to /contact-sales.
Optional: Accept query params ?plan=team&billing=yearly to set initial selection and focus.
acceptance_criteria: WCAG AA contrast for all text and interactive elements; visible 2px focus ring on all controls.
One clear primary action per plan card; no competing CTAs within a card.
Monthly/Yearly toggle updates all prices within 300ms and preserves scroll position; price change uses odometer animation, with reduced-motion honored.
Recommended plan is visually dominant via elevation, accent top rule, larger price, and badge; it appears first on mobile.
All interactive targets are ≥44×44px; keyboard navigation supports radiogroup and buttons; ESC dismisses tooltips.
URL query parameters reflect current selection (?billing=monthly|yearly and #plan anchors); loading state prevents duplicate checkouts.
Layout is responsive at 360/768/1280+ with no horizontal scroll; text measure kept within 45–75 characters.
Skeletons render while pricing fetches; error state includes retry and fallback prices if provided.
Pricing math is explicit: per-seat label visible; yearly state shows ‘Billed yearly at $X / seat’.
No decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no stock illustrations; iconography limited to functional cues only.
